name: agent-master-skills
description: Skills for AI coding agents — composable, disciplined, evidence-based. 18 skills across engineering, frontend, security, orchestration, and more.

plugins.name: agent-master-skills
plugins.description: Full skill library for AI coding agents — dev-craft, ui-craft, verification gates, parallel orchestration, and more.

skills.name: dev-craft
skills.description: Use when doing non-trivial coding work: building or changing features, fixing bugs, refactors and cleanup, migrations, schema/API/UI changes, architecture choices, reviewing a diff or PR comments, resuming earlier work. Skip typos, one-line edits, trivial config, quick questions, and throwaway scripts.

skills.name: ui-craft
skills.description: Use when building UI/UX features, design-system work or component libraries, redesigning an existing UI, adding animation and micro-interactions, or resuming a .ui-craft session. Runs the 10-phase frontend pipeline with persistent `.ui-craft` state. Do NOT use for a small UI tweak inside a feature (dev-craft covers it).

skills.name: product-thinking
skills.description: Use when input is vague or incomplete ("I have an idea...", "build me a CRM"), before planning. Turns it into a structured product spec through 4 rounds of refinement. Invoked by: dev-craft (input gate, Large planning).

skills.name: project-discovery
skills.description: Ingest existing specifications (xlsx/csv/md/pdf) into a domain model.

skills.name: documentation-engineering
skills.description: ADRs, API docs, docs-as-code pipelines, technical writing.

skills.name: devops-automation
skills.description: Use when deciding deployment mechanics, rollback strategy, CI/CD pipeline shape, or infrastructure-as-code choices (Terraform/Kubernetes, security-by-default config, deployment validation gates). Do NOT use for "is this ready to deploy" (see verification-before-completion) or for writing the pipeline YAML itself once the strategy is decided.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.description: Use when about to say "done", "fixed" or "complete" on work done outside dev-craft, or when proof must outlive the session (CI handoff, release, audit) via the hash-chained evidence ledger. Grades evidence FRESH/STALE/MISSING across 5 gates: structure, deterministic, security, convention, LLM judge. Inside dev-craft, its Verify step covers this.

skills.name: code-review-and-quality
skills.description: Use when a reviewer agent (code-reviewer, verifier) reviews a finished diff: eight-axis review with confidence-based filtering, a pre-report gate and false-positive suppression. For reviewing a diff or answering PR comments in the main session, use dev-craft.

skills.name: debugging-and-error-recovery
skills.description: Use when the cause of a bug, failing test, build break, 500 or unexpected behavior is not yet known: reproduce, form and test hypotheses, find the root cause before any fix, then prevent regression.

skills.name: image-to-design-spec
skills.description: Screenshot to design tokens, layout detection, design system generation.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description: Use when a session is long or near its context limit, when handing work to another agent or a later session (write a handoff doc), when resuming earlier work, or when pruning stale context.

skills.name: retro
skills.description: Weekly engineering retrospective with git analysis and trend tracking.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.description: Use when several tasks have no dependencies on each other and can run at the same time in subagents. Invoked by: dev-craft (parallel slices, Verifier / UI Verifier dispatch).

skills.name: eval-harness
skills.description: Golden regression of skills with pass@k metrics and code/model/human graders.

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Use when asked to "ship", "deploy", "push to main", "create a PR", "merge and push", or "get it deployed". Automated ship workflow: detect base branch, run tests, review diff, bump VERSION, update CHANGELOG, commit, push, create PR. (gstack)

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Use when creating a skill from scratch, editing or optimizing an existing skill, or adding a plugin in the agent-master-skills library. Follows the skill-composer integration pattern for dependency-aware loading.

skills.name: accessibility
skills.description: Use when designing, implementing, or auditing inclusive digital products for AI agents and LLM-powered applications.

skills.name: fe-visual-loop
skills.description: Use when building a new screen or page, a redesign, or component work too big to free-style but smaller than a full ui-craft run. Reference-first loop: starts from real reference sites the user picks (the agent finds 3-5 when none is given), extracts their structure into DESIGN.md, fills real content, mocks from the reference, gets an explicit pick, builds, then has ui-verifier compare build and reference at the same widths. Invoked by: dev-craft (Design step), ui-craft (Phases 2/3/8).
